sam: short recap 1: we want an infra-safe way to detect split-brain before doing live primary swaps. proposal: lightweight lease tokens + sequence vectors per tenant to detect divergent writes.

diego: operator signal wishlist: lease changes, divergence-count, kv-replication-lag. combine into a single incident score for automated gating.

mira: implementation sketch: per-tenant vector {us-east1: 102, eu-west1: 98}. on each local write increment local seq and attach vector metadata. divergence = writes observed with non-monotonic remote seq. cheap to store as compact blob in tenant meta.

tara: product question: if we quarantine a tenant during detection, what does the user see? propose emitting a tenant-facing notice in console and an event webhook for enterprise customers.

ellen: legal: any automatic reconciliation that results in EU-origin data moving outside EU must be blocked unless explicit consent exists. audit trail required for every reconcile action. retention = 13 months.

sam: conflict resolution policies: per-tenant config: prefer_primary, last_write_wins, manual_review. default = prefer_primary for safety. make manual_review require two approvers in UI for big merges.

mira: controlplane endpoint idea (idempotent):
```
POST /internal/tenant/swap
{
  "tenant_id": "t-42",
  "op": "lock" // lock | snapshot | promote | reconcile | rollback
}
```
lock -> switch tenant to write-through replication across candidate regions (short window) to gather stable frontier.

diego: runbook stub: detect -> soft-lock -> collect vectors -> attempt auto-merge if policy permits -> if conflict rate > threshold, escalate to manual. add global kill-switch for auto-quarantine.

tara: UX: show "last-reconcile" + small icon when a reconcile happened. expose conflict_policy only to enterprise tiers.

mira: testing: we need a synthetic harness that injects partitioned writes and validates detection. ops-bot can queue an integration job.

ops-bot: synthetic-job queued id=syn-20260501-11 target=30-tenants dur=20m logs=/var/log/syn/syn-20260501-11
diego: metrics to track: recon.incident_rate, recon.auto_resolve_pct, recon.duration_p95, tenant.p99_latency_during_lock. gating: p99 latency increase <20ms and auto_resolve_pct >90% in tests.

ell en: also require legal signoff before any canary that touches EU tenants.

sam: edge-case: third-party integrations that rely on region header. add a preflight probe that fetches tenant webhooks and runs header-echo checks; exclude failing tenants.

mira: storage cost: vectors add tiny metadata per-tenant. plan: compact encoding, rotate stale regions out of vector after quiet window.

diego: ops: add dashboard and alert templates. I'll draft alerts and the emergency rollback playbook.

tara: timeline: PoC (2w), canary 50 tenants (48h), expand if green. success: no customer-visible durability loss, auto-resolve >90%, <1.2x cost uplift for canary.

ell en: legal will draft audit + consent guidance and retention note (due next Tue).

sam: action items:
- mira: PoC lib + controlplane endpoint (2w)
- diego: runbook + alerts + kill-switch (1w)
- tara: console indicator + webhook event plan (next Tue)
- ellen: legal checklist + retention (next Tue)
- ops-bot: schedule synthetic job when PoC ready

sam: logging this decision here. we'll reconvene after PoC review. :white_check_mark:
